facts.text: Established in 1999, the Guaranteed Placement Program (GPP) integrates classroom instruction, experiential education, and career-focused workshops.

sources.title: Guaranteed Placement Program (GPP) - Misericordia University
sources.quote: Established in 1999, the GPP integrates classroom instruction, experiential education, and career‑focused workshops.

facts.text: Students may sign up for the Guaranteed Placement Program as first-time, full-time traditional first-year students or as transfer students entering with 63 credits or fewer.
